Hi Thomas — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the PO. Quick note on options we can offer and the trade-offs so procurement can decide: 

1) Conditional Net45 (recommended): we can agree to Net45 for the first 90 days with a limited credit buffer (15-25% holdback on month-1 invoices, release on completion of credit verification). This keeps your working capital flexibility while we complete standard credit checks.

2) Net60 (less preferred): we can offer Net60 if Helios provides an upfront security deposit equal to 30% of the estimated monthly run-rate or a corporate guarantee from an investment-grade parent.

3) Alternative: Net30 + 2% early-pay discount (if you can accelerate payment on a subset of invoices).

VAT / invoicing: we can issue invoices to Helios Health EU S.à r.l. provided you supply VAT registration and legal invoice name. We will also include a VAT breakdown and supplier VAT number on the invoice. Please attach the EU VAT cert.

Credit & docs we need to proceed: 
- Completed credit application (attached)
- Signed MSA (we can route via DocuSign — link below)
- Company registration and VAT cert for EU entity

Attachments: credit_app_helios.pdf (credit application, fill + sign)
Related DocuSign (MSA): https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-789
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/HLX-2026-0913

If procurement is able to accept the conditional Net45 + 15% holdback (we can reduce to 15% for a strategic pilot), well kick off the credit check and finance will provision an initial credit line within 48 hours of receiving the completed form. Let me know which route youd prefer and Ill loop in finance/legal to get the paperwork moving.

Thanks — Karthik
